project: Wuxia Life P109 Merchant Martial Patron Late-Life Design-First
description: Design-first contract stage for merchant_martial_patron late-life phase — define 3 late-life branches (one per payoff choice: covenant_holder/breaker/balancer), contract, and P110 validation shape. Docs-only; no runtime wiring.

userStories.title: Audit patron late-life prerequisites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit for the patron late-life stage so P109 starts from the real gating surfaces and not from assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize patron route flags, markers, events, expressions (P102-P108)
Document state differences across 3 payoff choices (stats, flags, identity, cost label, goal)
Identify what exists before late-life vs what can be reused
Compare with renown (P78) and magnate late-life precedents for patron-unique opportunities
Save docs/test-reports/p109-merchant-martial-patron-late-life-prerequisite-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Lock P109 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P109 stays design-first and does not slip into partial implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P109 to prerequisite audit, scope contract, branch design, late-life contract, validation shape, closure
Define allowed layers: documentation, contract, targeted proof planning
List forbidden expansions: runtime wiring, P102-P108 rewrite, magnate spine rewrite, endgame design, new UI
Save docs/test-reports/p109-merchant-martial-patron-late-life-scope-contract.md
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Design three late-life branches (per payoff choice)
userStories.description: As a designer, I want three distinct late-life branches so patron late-life leverages the 3-choice payoff structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Design covenant_holder late-life branch: core narrative + trigger + player experience (盟约绑紧)
Design covenant_breaker late-life branch: core narrative + trigger + player experience (自由孤立)
Design balancer late-life branch: core narrative + trigger + player experience (新盟可持续)
Three branches have meaningfully different identities (not reskinned)
Cover at least 1 native + 1 bridge-origin entry overlay priority rules
Decide single auto event with 3 branches vs multi-event (recommend single auto for boundedness)
Differentiate from magnate and renown late-life
Save design document
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define patron late-life contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit late-life contract so P110 knows exactly what flags, gates, events, and player-facing meanings must be closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Define late-life checkpoint merchant_patron_late_life_done, required flags, gate acceptance
Define late-life event structure (recommend auto with 3 branches keyed on payoff marker)
Define stat changes, identity markers, expression differences per branch
Define at least 3 late-life-specific player-facing signals
Clarify late-life vs payoff vs magnate/renown late-life
Reserve merchant_patron_endgame_echo_done for P111+
Save contract to docs/PRD/p109-merchant-martial-patron-late-life-contract.md
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define P110 validation shape
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the P110 validation shape fixed in advance so playable late-life work is judged against explicit expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: Define targeted proof chain nodes (payoff to late-life to expression changes)
All 3 payoff branches must have core node verification
Define minimum regression coverage: P102-P108 patron, P97-P101 magnate, guard:sample-lines-baseline
Define closure criteria count and threshold (P108 12-criteria pattern)
No full lifetime exhaust required
Save validation shape document
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Produce P109 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the patron late-life design-first contract and hands off to P110.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p109-merchant-martial-patron-late-life-closure-report.md
Summarize audit, scope, branch design, contract, validation shape
Clarify P110 boundary and list deferred patron-expansion items
State GO or NO-GO for P110 playable late-life with rationale
Typecheck passes
